answer_1.quote: The framework consists of three stages: Firstly, an LLM examiner agent is tasked with generating questions, mimicking real-life users posting queries. Secondly, two LLM candidates interact with each other and engage in a multi-round peer battle by answering the seed question individually, criticizing the opponent's weaknesses, and raising targeted follow-up queries to challenge the opponent further.
answer_1.outputs: generated questions, multi-turn peer battle responses, committee judgments

answer_2.quote: Without any manual efforts involved, Auto-Arena produces the state-of-the-art alignment by achieving a 92.14% Spearman correlation with human preferences.

answer_3.quote: a committee of LLM judges collectively discusses and evaluates the ability of the two candidates, mimicking the human voting process.

answer_4.quote: A notable example is Chatbot Arena, a crowdsourcing platform that gathers anonymous votes on LLM performances and calculates Elo scores to rank these models.
answer_4.guideline: users vote on which model response is better based on helpfulness, relevance, and accuracy
